narr: Strong low pressure moving northward along the coast produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of southeast Virginia and the Virginia Eastern Shore.
ev: Streets were flooded. Road was closed. Vehicles were stranded.
Flooding was reported at Boush Street and Olney Road. Intersection was covered with water.
Flooding was reported at Route 264 near Effingham Street.
Flooding was reported on Interstate 64 West in Hampton. Portions of the interstate were flooded reducing traffic to one lane.
High water was reported near the intersection between White Marsh Road and Hosier Road.
Flooding was reported at Mill Swamp Road towards Proctors Bridge Road.
All lanes were closed on Route 692 near Sand Street due to high water.
All lanes were closed on Route 619 (Church Neck Road) in the vicinity of Glebe Road.
